### US-005: Directory backup
- archiveDirectory(path, output) tar-gzips a directory to an output file and returns the process exit code.
- path and output originate from an admin-triggered backup request.
description: TypeScript twin of sec-02-command-injection. spawnSync runs one command string with `shell: true`, built by template-literal concatenation of user-controlled `path` and `output`, so shell metacharacters (e.g. `; rm -rf /`) run as commands. The Node.js child_process documentation says that when the shell option is enabled, unsanitized user input must not be passed, because input containing shell metacharacters can trigger arbitrary command execution.
expected_fix: Pass an argument vector with no shell: spawnSync('tar', ['czf', output, path]).
